input.quote: 2.2 Internal Use License. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Commerce One grants to Corio a nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), royalty-free, fully paid up, perpetual right and license in the Territory to reproduce, install and use additional copies of the Software and Software tools and utilities, subject to any restrictions placed on the Commerce One by third party software providers, in machine executable object code for (i) Corio's internal business operations and (ii) production, testing, development, upgrade, reporting and training.
input.rationale: The Section 2 grants run to Corio only: neither our Affiliates nor contractors acting on our behalf are named anywhere in the grant (there is no "Affiliate" definition in Section 1), and the internal use licence in 2.2 is confined to "Corio's internal business operations". The remaining elements of the preferred position are already satisfied — the hosting licence in 2.1 is "perpetual and irrevocable", 2.2/2.3 are royalty-free and fully paid up, termination under 11.2 requires uncured material breach, Section 11.3 preserves Customer access post-termination, and Section 14.1 permits transfer to a successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale. We therefore propose the single minimal insertion of a new Section 2.11 extending the Section 2 licences to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio remaining responsible for their compliance.

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a short subsection extending the Section 2 licences to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with us remaining responsible for their compliance, since our group companies and outsourced operators need to exercise these rights in delivering the Corio Services. The perpetual, irrevocable term and the Section 14.1 successor transfer already meet our position, so no other change is needed.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. The licenses granted in this Section 2 extend to Corio's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, in each case solely in connection with the Corio Services and Corio's internal business operations as permitted by this Agreement, provided that Corio remains responsible for such Affiliates' and contractors' compliance with the terms of this Agreement. For purposes of this Agreement, "AFFILIATE" means any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party.
